high_level_description: The image is a split-screen photograph featuring two different scenes. On the left side of the image, there is a man and a woman standing on a cobblestone street. The man is dressed in a formal black suit with a white shirt and a black tie. He has a medal pinned to his left lapel. The woman is wearing an elegant blue saree with intricate detailing along the edges. She has her hair styled in loose waves and is accessorized with a ring on her right hand. Both individuals are smiling and appear to be posing for the photo.
